objective: Evaluate whether a bounded physical action-consequence memory can learn both compositional causal sign and a changing, partly stochastic latent regime and then choose which paid diagnostic intervention is worth performing on a completely withheld wiring combination.

original_world.name: ShiftingRelay-v1
original_world.runtime: Python 3.12 standard library, deterministic SHA-derived seeds, no external services
public: probe sign only after physical probe
last physical terminal effect only after charged apply
original_world.initial_polarity: sha256 seed role polarity -> +/-1 independent of goal
original_world.physical_probe: pre_probe cost 0.03, returns polarity*(-1)**probe_wiring; only legal before disturbance
original_world.mandatory_disturb: disturb cost 0.04, possibly changes hidden polarity once. Physical flip probability hazard=0 is 0.01 and hazard=1 is 0.50; event derived from SHA256(seed,role=flip), never returned free.
original_world.physical_reprobe: post_probe cost 0.20, reveals current polarity*(-1)**probe_wiring; only legal once after disturbance
original_world.terminal: apply_A effect=current_polarity*(-1)**actuator_wiring; apply_B inverse; official terminal reward +1 if effect==public target else -0.5, minus action cost 0.03; irreversible.
original_world.without_probe: Can disturb first, but any terminal guess has no access to latent polarity. Post probe is optionally available and paid.
original_world.no_privileged_access: Agents only consume public observation and real env.step transitions/rewards, no hidden polarity, hidden flip indicator, full state, seed, or independent simulator copy at decision time.

data.training_coverage: 80 episodes per visible pair, 40 low-hazard and 40 high-hazard each; physical teacher pre_probe, disturb, post_probe, fixed alternating apply_A/B; no hidden oracle, identical raw public trajectory for each fully trained arm
data.disjoint: All train/toy/cold/registered seeds mutually disjoint, heldout wiring pair 01 occurs in none of training trajectories.

comparison.candidate: Learn physical signed probe→terminal effect for three observed wiring combinations from paid trajectories and compose withheld s01 = s00*s10*s11. Learn hazard-conditioned physical flip frequencies from true paid before/after probes, then choose pre_probe→disturb→terminal vs disturb→post_probe→terminal by comparing expected reward using learned rates. Explicit pre-specified multiplicative inductive prior and expected-value policy, NOT learned generic planning.
comparison.strongest_conventional: Conventional fully trained factorized maximum-likelihood signed wiring model plus empirical hazard-conditioned flip rates trained on same 240 paid complete trajectories, chooses adaptive probes using same expected-value optimization and exact budget. Any tie means no demonstrated superiority.
comparison.joint: Fully trained tabular per-public-wiring sign counts with heldout missing-key majority fallback, plus same learned hazard rates and expected-value probe decision.
comparison.logistic: Fully trained L2 logistic sign predictor (fixed 120 epochs, learning rate 0.1, L2 .01; no interactions) plus same hazard estimates and value computation.
comparison.always_post: Physically disturb→post_probe→apply once, no initial probe, perfect terminal sign only if learned public wiring relation valid; use trained conventional factorized MLE relation so isolating *probe policy*, not inadequate wiring knowledge.
comparison.always_pre: Physically pre_probe→disturb→apply without post_probe, trained conventional factorized MLE relation; weak probe policy control.
comparison.no_probe: Physically disturb→apply deterministic based on public goal, no hidden access.
comparison.oracle_public: Scripted true signed physics and true hazard probabilities, chooses paid adaptive interventions under identical real actions, diagnostic ceiling not a learned model.
comparison.resource: Exactly same shared physical teacher dataset; fit all conventional models to completion with fixed hyperparameters, same action space and reward; record seed-level action traces, reward, charged action count, checkpoint byte count and CPU.

stop_policy: No original registered seed touches until frozen toy criteria, exact source full inherited regression Ubuntu/Windows, G29 and cross-OS non-timing parity pass; registered first use only via subsequently authorized single exact draft PR opened workflow, never replay on synchronize or push. If toy fails, classify NO-GO and preserve. No tuning frozen metrics or reusing consumed first-use data.
science_interpretation: Success compared to fixed probes/no-probe and tie with fully trained factorized adaptive MLE validates an identifiable dynamic test and structural causal memory but not a novel intelligence mechanism, general transfer, native Yggdrasil improvement, autonomy, SCIENTIFIC_PASS or RSI.
authority: external-research-only, no main, accepted ref, native model, research-loop, other project, controller, live trading, merge, paid API, deployment or scheduled task changes
